name: hexagon2-videomasking
blurb: Looping video clipped into an alternate hexagon shape using CSS mask.
description: Plays a muted, auto-looping video masked by a hexagon SVG. Uses CSS mask-image pointing to /hexagon2.svg (alternate hexagon design).
use_when: Hero or feature sections with a different hexagon aesthetic than hexagon-videomasking.
avoid_when: Browsers without CSS mask support. The SVG mask file must be available at /hexagon2.svg.
a11y: Video is muted and autoplays. Purely decorative. No controls or alternatives.
